_about: Probe list for scripts/monitor/check.py (T235). Edit here, not in the code.

http.name: cdn-host
http._note: Enable once the cdn custom domain resolves (stage 5). Any HTTP answer proves the zone and the R2 binding are up.

http.name: supabase-auth
http._note: 401 without a key still proves the project answers. With SUPABASE_ANON_KEY set it expects 200.

wire_layers._note: Row count floors for the published wire, read from the data host. Floors are about 80 percent of the figures in Execution/P4/T072-pipeline-health-metrics.md (beaches 2746, lakes 1681, mountains 740, trails 17619, cycling 506).

pipeline._note: 216 h is nine days: a weekly run, a day of grace, and a day for the check cadence.
